included: Signed tool requests from an agent to the authorization proxy
Agent status and active public-key lookup
Security audit records for allow and deny outcomes
excluded: Security of third-party tools after an approved invocation
Cloud deployment availability and disaster recovery
Human identity proofing for agent enrollment

assets.description: The binding between an agent identifier and its active Ed25519 public key
The signed tool name, arguments, session, timestamp, and nonce
The least-privilege rules used to allow, deny, or require step-up approval
A short-lived approval bound to one agent and session
Decision records used to reconstruct authorization outcomes

trust_boundaries.description: Untrusted agent input crosses into the authorization proxy
The proxy reads agent status and active public keys from the registry
The proxy sends a bounded decision input to the policy engine
Authorization evidence leaves the request path for durable storage

controls.description: Verify an Ed25519 signature over canonical request fields
Reject unknown, revoked, or keyless agent identities
Enforce bounded clock skew and atomically reserve each nonce
Evaluate explicit tool and risk rules with deny as the fallback
Bind short-lived approval to the requesting agent and session
Reject oversized identifiers, arguments, and malformed encodings before expensive work
Record decision inputs and a chained digest in an append-only format
Store approved evidence fields and redact configured sensitive values

evidence.description: Planned tests for changed arguments, malformed signatures, and retired keys
Planned tests for reused nonces and past or future timestamps
Planned policy cases for allowed tools, denied tools, and step-up decisions
Planned tests for cross-agent, cross-session, and expired step-up tokens
Planned tests for malformed and oversized request fields
Planned tests that detect deletion, reordering, and mutation of audit records
Planned tests that ensure configured sensitive argument values are not persisted

threats.title: Agent identity spoofing
threats.abuse_case: A caller presents another agent identifier or a signature from an unregistered key.
threats.residual_risk: A stolen active private key remains valid until it is revoked or rotated.

threats.title: Signed request tampering
threats.abuse_case: An intermediary changes a tool or argument after the agent signs the request.
threats.residual_risk: Canonicalization bugs can create different meanings for the same signed bytes.

threats.title: Captured request replay
threats.abuse_case: A valid signed request is submitted again inside or outside its accepted time window.
threats.residual_risk: Distributed nonce stores can fail open if consistency and failure behavior are not explicit.

threats.title: Decision repudiation
threats.abuse_case: A decision is denied later because its evidence was omitted, changed, reordered, or deleted.
threats.residual_risk: A digest chain does not prevent an administrator from deleting the entire store.

threats.title: Sensitive argument disclosure through audit records
threats.abuse_case: Secrets or personal data in tool arguments are copied into a broadly readable audit record.
threats.residual_risk: Unknown sensitive fields may not match the configured redaction policy.

threats.title: Authentication resource exhaustion
threats.abuse_case: A caller sends many expensive or oversized invalid requests to consume CPU or dependency capacity.
threats.residual_risk: Application validation does not replace connection and service rate limits.

threats.title: Tool privilege escalation
threats.abuse_case: An authenticated agent requests a tool outside its intended permissions or reuses another session's approval.
threats.residual_risk: A policy can still allow unsafe behavior if tool impact or argument context is modeled incorrectly.
